tickets.title: Prepare Care Coverage Comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a side‑by‑side comparison of in‑home aide coverage, adult day programs, short‑term respite stays, transportation options, and projected out‑of‑pocket costs for Harold and Lena Velvetreed under various weekly care‑hour scenarios.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare that comparison by 2026-01-20.

tickets.title: Build Family Caregiver Coverage Map
tickets.text: Build a caregiver coverage map that documents Sofia Copperwisp’s weekend availability, Martin Velvetreed’s remote medication support, and other family resources to illustrate how the Velvetreed household will meet daily care needs.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to build a family caregiver coverage map by 2026-01-16.

tickets.title: Prepare Insurance Claim Intake Packet
tickets.text: Prepare an intake packet for the Silver Marmot Insurance claim appointment that includes physician orders, care notes, aide agency estimates, invoices, and a list of policy questions for Harold and Lena Velvetreed.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to prepare the intake packet by 2026-01-12.

tickets.title: Resolve Aide Shift Minimums
tickets.text: Resolve the inconsistency in aide shift minimums by reconciling the agency’s four‑hour daytime shift requirement with Sofia’s three‑hour visit notes for the Velvetreed care cost estimates.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to resolve the aide shift minimums in the cost estimates by 2026-01-13.

tickets.title: Correct Secure Upload Access
tickets.text: Correct the secure upload access issue by configuring a separate login for Lena Velvetreed so her care records, health forms, and aide invoices can be uploaded independently of Harold’s portal.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to correct secure upload access by 2026-01-09.

tickets.title: Address Policy Benefit Inflation Assumptions
tickets.text: Address the differing inflation rider language in the two Silver Marmot Insurance policies to ensure the daily benefit maximums are accurately reflected in the Velvetreed care‑cost projections.
tickets.evidence: the agreed follow-up is to address the policy benefit inflation assumptions by 2026-01-23.
